items.text: This is the first table in the project where the external system behind the recurring 'HQ' label has been identified by name (HQAnalytics). Two other tables, ADJ_CD_DIM and AD_GRP_DIM, carry the same 'HQ' label, but it has not been confirmed that they come from the same system. The similar naming of their source data suggests a possible link, but this is not yet verified.
This table has a single confirmed process that loads it daily. Every row is marked as coming from the same external system (HQ), with no sign of a competing process or placeholder records.

The full path this data takes is confirmed end to end: it is staged, then matched against store and advertising group information before loading. The staging step connects to a SQL Server system named HQAnalytics to pull the source data.
No data quality issues found. Every store and advertising group reference is valid, and there are no duplicate pairs.
